column4: Slow sway and stretches before bed; voice or on-screen guide; dims the screen.

column3: Premium
column4: Sequences to ease tension and stress: shake-out, tense-and-release, slow stretching, rocking and swaying. Voice OR on-screen guide (user chooses); user sets 2–20 minutes. Wording: 'eases tension and stress'. Never 'treats pain' or 'releases trauma'.

column3: All
column4: Shown once and on every guided session: 'Skip any move that hurts. Stop if pain gets worse. If you have ongoing pain or an injury, check with your GP or physiotherapist.' Sequences reviewed by a physiotherapist or registered dance movement psychotherapist before launch.

column3: All
column4: Users play their own music (from their device) or royalty-free tracks built into FigCit. No commercial tracks are bundled.

column3: Rule
Create sits under Regulate. Write sits under Express.
Draw, paint and design on one canvas, with Save and Upload (photo or image from the device). Tools: pens, brushes, colours, shapes, text.
Free: draw and save up to 10 pieces. Prime: paint and design tools, unlimited saves, upload. Premium: everything in Prime plus design templates.
An idea sorted as image or diagram opens here (DR-4).
Saved and uploaded pieces are private, never shared or shown to organisations, and can be deleted at any time.
3D builder: shapes and objects to build anything, colour it and download a 3D image (Prime or Premium, decided before build). Roadmap, not MVP.
A writing panel with Save; ideas in words from Dump open here (DR-3). 'Ask for what I need' and 'Notes for my appointment' templates live here too.
